description: In a bakery with dark green tiles, shelves of round loaves and a glowing brass oven, a smiling young man in a white t-shirt and grey apron sprinkles flour into the left pan of a tall brass beam balance, while the right pan holds a small brass weight. He then lowers his hand and watches as the two pans hang almost level. The balance stands on a marble counter beside a linen sack and bowls. A brass lamp hangs above, and a golden puppy sleeps on the speckled floor below.
